# aigentify

> Audit and generate agent-native product surfaces.

## Product

aigentify checks a local product directory or live URL. It reports gaps in public agent instructions, MCP discovery, Offer JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, /auth.md, /.well-known/api-catalog, A2A agent-card, Link headers, and markdown alternates. For live URLs it also checks agent reachability, real HTTP 404s (not soft-404 app shells), markdown content negotiation, server-rendered content, Organization schema (contactPoint + address), an openapi.json, an /agents page, and standard rate-limit headers.

## Interfaces

- Library: `auditTarget` and `generate`.
- CLI: `aigentify audit`, `aigentify init`, `aigentify gen`, and `aigentify mcp`.
- MCP: `audit` and `gen` over stdio.
